layout: Full-width heading; text at left and one optional project infrastructure photograph at right. Stack photograph below text on mobile <=767px. No captions or cards. Existing typography, spacing and two-paragraph disclosure retained.

content_contract.when_empty: Do not render the section or navigation anchor. Do not infer infrastructure features from another field or fill manually.

disclosure.condition: Only show Читать далее when there are more than two non-empty paragraphs.
disclosure.paragraph_format: Top-level p elements; plain text line breaks or br-only markup normalized into paragraphs without parsing HTML strings. Empty paragraphs ignored.
disclosure.accessibility: Native button with aria-expanded/controls; the remaining paragraphs use hidden and leave the tab/accessibility order while collapsed.
disclosure.updates: Re-evaluate when text changes. Without JS the whole original text remains visible.

preview: Static example reuses the infrastructure facts already present in this prototype before section removal. This is not a fresh Intrum export; replace whole text from the public infrastructure field when the CRM adapter is connected.
user_examples: Рождественка 8 includes a filled Infrastructure field; ЖК Гала example does not. The block is conditional.

image.provenance: preview/assets/sources.json: garden.jpg, official project asset checked 2026-11-10
image.when_empty: Omit figure and apply infrastructure-layout--text-only; do not show placeholder or fetch an unrelated image.
image.integration: Use an available verified infrastructure image from the project media feed; exact CRM media mapping must be defined by adapter.
